verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Markdown > Math disabled, the preview should show the line literally: "Costs $5 and $10" — both dollar signs preserved.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The preview displays "Costs 5 and 10" — both '$' characters are silently dropped from the text.
steps: Open Files and tap Money.md (content: 'Costs $5 and $10').
Go to More > Settings > Markdown and confirm the Math (KaTex) checkbox is OFF.
Return to Money.md and tap View Mode.
Observe the rendered line: 'Costs 5 and 10' instead of 'Costs $5 and $10'.
Reproduced again in a scratch Markdown file containing 'A $x^2$ B and Costs $5 and $10 C' while Math is off: preview shows 'A x^2 B and Costs 5 and 10 C'.

verdicts_or_reports.field: Step-by-step replace with regular expression enabled
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With 'Use Regular Expression' enabled, searching `cat(@home)` and replacing with `$1` via the step-by-step Replace (1) action should substitute the captured group, producing `@home dog@home` — the same result as 'Replace all'.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Replace (1) inserts the replacement as literal text: the editor becomes `$1 dog@home`. Running 'Replace all' with the identical search/replacement and regex enabled produces `@home dog@home`, so the step-by-step path does not match the batch path.
steps: Open Regex2.md (line 'cat@home dog@home') and tap Search.
Type search text `cat(@home)` and open the replace row.
Type replacement `$1` and enable 'Use Regular Expression'.
Close the dialog, tap Undo to restore `cat@home dog@home`.
Repeat the same search/replacement and tap 'Replace all': editor shows `@home dog@home` (captured group substituted).

sign_off.notes: Swept all three areas. Confirmed and logged two defects: (1) View Mode drops '$' characters from dollar-pair text (Money.md shows "Costs 5 and 10" instead of "Costs $5 and $10") even with Markdown Math disabled; reproduced in a scratch file with "$x^2$" and "$5 ... $10" (scratch file deleted afterwards). (2) With Find/Replace regex enabled, step-by-step Replace (1) inserts "$1" literally ("$1 dog@home") while Replace all substitutes the capture group ("@home dog@home"). Other checks passed: sort by Name/Date with Folder first and Reverse order produced correctly reversed sequences, reverse stayed checked when switching sort key, Cancel discarded pending changes, and sort persisted across navigation; editor move-line-up/down are each a single undo step (including two consecutive moves undone one at a time, and no-op at file top), duplicate line works; search count updates after its debounce; view mode rendered headings, links, nested bullets, escaped markup and the no-trailing-newline Single.md correctly, and rotation preserved editor/view content. Test data restored (QAtmp removed; Notes.md, Regex2.md and Indent2.md back to original content; sort returned to Name ascending / Folder first / Reverse off; Math extension back to its initial off state).
